text:
Ava S: incident-bot just paged for elevated tail latency on generation-service (kv cache hot shard) in us-west-1 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: GENERATION_KV_HOTSHARD — 95p latency > 1.2s for 2min. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Pager: #pager-ops, playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/generation-kv-hotshard
Marco L: I'm primary for this window — taking ownership. Priya, can you be secondary?
Priya N: on it, going to grab recent dashboards and run a quick impact check. ETA 5m
Samir K: FYI I have a customer call in ~15m but can jump if we need a kernel change or node reboot.
Ava S: quick notes for handoff->primary: check K/V eviction pressure, recent autoscaler events, and eviction logs. Runbook shortlinks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-troubleshoot
Marco L: starting with dashboards: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/kvcache/kv-shards?orgId=1&var-region=us-west-1 — seeing one shard with 99th spike.
Priya N: running quick curl to list hot keys from the debug endpoint:
```
curl -sS "https://internal-api.redwood.ai/debug/kv/hotkeys?shard=svc-03" | jq '.hotkeys | .[0:10]'
```
Priya N: output shows repeated prefix "ctx:embed:" across many keys — likely client-side fanout or bad prefixing.
Samir K: also check serving runtime logs for KV exceptions:
```
journalctl -u redwood-serving.service -n 200 --no-pager | grep -E "KV|evict|throttle"
```
Ava S: immediate mitigations from runbook we should try in order: 1) route heavy routes to warm fallback model variant (low-cost) 2) trigger cache-eviction on offending shard 3) add temporary routing rule to spread reads across kvcache replicas.
Marco L: triggering fallback route for /v1/generate now (canary 10%). Command in infra-tooling:
```
redctl route update --service generation --route /v1/generate --fallback model:gen-small --weight 10
```
Marco L: done, canary applied — traffic dropped slightly. Monitoring 1m windows.
Priya N: issuing eviction on svc-03: `kvctl evict --shard svc-03 --pattern "ctx:embed:*" --dry-run` then actual eviction after sanity check.
Priya N: dry-run looks correct, performing eviction now.
incident-bot: Eviction job started: job_id=evict-2026-03-15-01, status=running. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/jobs/evict-2026-03-15-01
Samir K: good call. Also bump replica read_weight for svc-03 to 1.5 temporarily via autoscaler API.
Marco L: autoscaler change submitted. Watching latency — 95p dropping from 1.3s -> 0.5s. Nice.
Ava S: quick customer impact note: estimated 8% of requests in us-west-1 saw degraded latency for ~18m, now partial mitigation in place. I'll draft the header for status page.
Priya N: adding checklist items to handoff for the night team: link to eviction job, route change ID, autoscaler change ID, and key hotlist. https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=kv-hotshard-2026-03-15
Marco L: for postmortem runbook pointer: run full data collection script
```
bash tools/incident/collect.sh --incident evict-2026-03-15 --out /tmp/evict-2026-03-15.tar.gz
```
Samir K: tagging @oncall-rota for next shift awareness. Please include the cleanup window to re-balance replicas (we should reverse autoscaler tweak after 2 hours).
oncall-rota: Noted — next primary on rotation is Priya (overnight), secondary Samir. Will add to shift notes and escalate to infra if hotspots reappear.
Ava S: handoff summary (for the next on-call): primary=Priya N, secondary=Samir K, mitigations applied=[canary fallback, shard eviction, autoscaler bump], runbook_refs=[https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/generation-kv-hotshard, https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache], impact_summary="~8% requests high tail latency in us-west-1 for ~18min".
Priya N: I'll follow through on post-eviction checks and leave residual tasks in the ticket (INC-2026-0315). Leaving detailed steps and timestamps in the ticket.
Marco L: tagging on-call handover complete. If anything regresses ping @Priya N or page #pager-ops again. :thumbsup:
